findings.observation: The corrected checkpoint cutover has no boundary marker between interactions queued before and after Ready, so its drain-to-empty policy drops both classes.
findings.impact: An interaction produced after server Ready but before an overlapping checkpoint completes is discarded, violating post-Ready FIFO preservation.
findings.recommendation: Establish an explicit ordered interaction cutover when Ready is observed; drop only pre-marker interactions, buffer post-marker interactions FIFO, and submit them after checkpoint reconciliation. Add a synchronized regression.
evidence: session.rs observes Ready while checkpoint may continue.
establish_realtime_cutover drains every immediately available control event before activating interactions.
the r1 regression emits its post-Ready interaction only after checkpoint completion.

findings.observation: Task completion has polling priority, but terminal state is not rechecked after receiving a buffered owner event, leaving a poll-to-return race.
findings.impact: One stale peer event can reach the ROM after the realtime task becomes terminal.
findings.recommendation: Recheck or nonblocking-poll the JoinHandle after owner-event receipt and before mapping/return; add a barrier-controlled regression.
evidence: realtime.rs checks JoinHandle::is_finished only before select.
the JoinHandle may first poll Pending and finish before a buffered event returns.
the saturation test begins only after is_finished is already true.

findings.observation: The suite adds a successful path but does not execute freshest-state handoff during mint or active reset/backpressure/child-failure cleanup through production lifecycle.
findings.impact: Several required fence and teardown paths can regress without an activation-level failure.
findings.recommendation: Add deterministic activation-level tests for pending mint with fresher state and active terminal failures, asserting one attempt, freshest initial state, no post-terminal output, and joined cleanup.
evidence: the successful fake grant is immediately ready and has no delayed mint seam.
successful and checkpoint tests do not induce active reset, backpressure, or child failure.
LRA2-006 explicitly requires freshest-state and active cleanup coverage.
